direction: Date-and-place card over an establishing still. Spring morning, April 1872. The new St Dochdwy's Church stands on the inland hill at Llandough. It is six years old and its dressed stone is still pale and clean. The churchyard grass is short and wet, with older headstones leaning beyond the new walls. In the far distance, below the hill, are the Ely valley, the marshes and the grey line of the estuary. Slow push in towards the vestry door.
